decisions.reason: This close-in hearing product disappeared from the website by 2024, which suggests weak traction or replacement and makes it a low-priority use of resources.
Although it had its own launch page in 2023, its absence from the website in 2024 points to limited market success or consolidation within the hearing earmold range.
The vacuum thermoforming unit remained actively presented in 2023 and 2024 and fits the firm's core equipment business for specialist medical-technology workflows.
The orthopedic shoe last is outside the firm's main dental and hearing focus, and despite a 2024 product page it is strategically too distant from the integrated core portfolio.
The post-curing unit is a close fit with the firm's digital and automated production strategy, and as a 2024 launch it deserves more time to build adoption.
